claims.claim: Every charitable collection in a public street or place in England and Wales needs a street collection licence.
claims.quote: If you want to collect money or sell items on the street for charity, you might need a street collection licence, depending on your local council.
claims.note: The page says a licence might be needed depending on the council, rather than for every collection.

claims.claim: A street collection licence is free to obtain.
claims.note: Neither source states a fee or says the licence is free.

claims.claim: Greater London collections outside the City of London go through the Metropolitan Police.
claims.quote: In Greater London (except the City of London) you’ll need to contact the Metropolitan Police for a licence.
claims.note: The source identifies the Metropolitan Police route and the City of London exception.

claims.claim: Collecting for charity without a licence can lead to a £200 fine.
claims.quote: You could be fined £200 if you collect money for charity without a licence.
claims.note: The source states the possible £200 fine.
